component.name: Select
component.description: A native <select> restyled with a custom chevron — the only form control in the system besides dialog text inputs. Used to pick a model/reasoning tier per agent in Settings.

commonPatterns.name: settings-row-select
commonPatterns.description: Paired with a visible label in a settings row.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Select for more than ~8-10 options or when search is needed
antiPatterns.reason: this is a plain native select with no search/combobox behavior
antiPatterns.alternative: There is no combobox component in this system yet — don't fake one by overloading Select

antiPatterns.scenario: Omitting a visible label or aria-label
antiPatterns.reason: the control must be identifiable to assistive tech
antiPatterns.alternative: Always pair with a label[for] or pass aria-label

states: focus-visible (2px focus ring — the reference implementation for this system)

accessibility.keyboardSupport: native select keyboard behavior (arrow keys, type-ahead)
accessibility.screenReader: must be paired with a visible label, not placeholder-only text

aiHints.context: The only select-style form control in the system. Single size, no variants.
